executive_summary: Frozen SPD direction translated into exactly 0.10 V5.1 SD. Already exposed research, not independent validation. Primary cannot be replaced by secondary results.
direction: sign(exact frozen LOCATION04 SPD_FULL5_RELEASE_BALANCED out-of-fold prediction), zero remains zero

OOD3_DIAGNOSTIC.rule: Zero shift iff any of five original inputs has absolute z >3 using its preserved original asset/horizon/year TRAIN scaler; otherwise primary 0.10 SD shift

origin_selection: Exact original LOCATION04 eval_mask/scored_rows; never expand, drop or recompute origins
source_rules: Original SPD publication/PIT, 70 weekday age expiry, all original horizons, original chronological purge and target maturity cutoff 2024-12-18 unchanged
geometry: Every original draw + one per-cell additive shift; no rescaling, shape/tail/copula/rank changes or jitter. Disclose rounding ties.
score: Pinned qfbench2-common v2.4.3 crps_ensemble(fair=True), per-cell divide by frozen past normalization scale, original competition-style ratio of sums. This is research marginal CRPS, not a Development call or official multi-card composite.
oracle: Exact frozen same-ledger perfect-location losses, reconstruct with original baseline median shifted to truth only for diagnostic verification after PRE
direction_metrics: Reuse prior weighted mid-CDF rank Spearman and equal total mass per original release. Rank metric describes frozen continuous source prediction, not binary sign or the perfect oracle.

controls.RELEASE_SIGN_SHUFFLE: Permute frozen direction packets across release IDs inside equal asset/horizon coverage-signature strata; same donor release across all assets/horizons. Within donor packet choose same asset/horizon row nearest pre-outcome source age; earlier origin then original row order breaks ties. No outcome-aware matching. This permutation null intentionally destroys historical release association; it is not a PIT-valid deployable forecast.
controls.DATE_PERMUTED_DIRECTION: Safely permute nonnegative0..20 repository business-day activation delays across original SPD release-date slots, never activate before actual availability. Select latest delayed original state at unchanged origin cutoff; preserve full5 usability and original age<=70. Use its already frozen same-asset/horizon direction from latest donor forecast origin <= current origin; absent donor state means zero shift, recorded on unchanged full ledger. This is an explicitly delayed date-mapping null, not a new fitted model or a literal unrestricted date permutation.
controls.RANDOM_SIGN: Permute the complete frozen cellular sign vector, preserving exact positive/negative/zero prevalence, same fixed magnitude; no IID-cell inference from this null
controls.ONE_YEAR_SHIFT: For each exact current asset/horizon, select latest already frozen eligible origin no later than current origin minus one calendar year; require donor no more than40 weekdays earlier than that query, otherwise zero. Full552-cell comparison plus mechanical coverage reported; no available-only favorable subset. No refit.
controls.FUTURE_MUTATION: Mutate future original SPD fields and append a2099 state; original asof features and frozen-direction earlier candidate shifts must remain bitwise identical
controls.OUTCOME_MUTATION: Mutate truth/delta/cell losses in copied ledger; shifts and candidate draw construction from frozen prediction/SD must remain bitwise identical

controls_comparison.inferior: Each stochastic null median ratio > primary +1e-12 and ONE_YEAR_SHIFT ratio > primary +1e-12
controls_comparison.clearly_inferior: Inferior plus each stochastic null fraction at least as good <0.05, add-one empirical p=(1+count)/(2001)
controls_comparison.generally_inferior: Each stochastic null median and ONE_YEAR_SHIFT are inferior; report full null tail probabilities, no selection among controls
controls_comparison.similar_or_better: Any stochastic null median or deterministic prior-year ratio <= primary +1e-12; primary NO, secondary cannot rescue

concentration.NONCONCENTRATED: No release >50% gross positive release gain AND every leave-one-year-out ratio <1; also report stricter leave-one-release/asset/horizon ranges and signs. No deletion used to redefine primary.

success_gates.STRONG_YES: Primary ratio<=0.95, capture>=0.10, >=4/5 years<1, release upper95CI<1, year upper95CI<=1, controls clearly inferior, nonconcentrated
success_gates.YES: Primary ratio<=0.97, capture>=0.05, >=3/5 years<1, release upper95CI<1, controls inferior, no one release>50% positive gain and nonconcentrated
success_gates.WEAK_YES: Primary ratio<0.99, more original annual folds improve than worsen, controls generally inferior, original release-balanced direction accuracy>=0.55 and rank>=0.10 retained
success_gates.NO: Meaningful primary degradation ratio>=1.01 OR similar/better null control OR original release-balanced direction <=chance and rank<=0
success_gates.INCONCLUSIVE: Otherwise; near baseline, broad intervals, concentrated gain or conflicting inference. Report limitations even for weak verdict. No secondary substitution.

gate_priority: NO exclusion first, then STRONG_YES, YES, WEAK_YES, else INCONCLUSIVE
private_public: Outcomes, cell losses, control arrays and full draw arrays private; only aggregate evidence/provenance/hash manifests public
